name: Spore Burst (Alluria Publishing)
body:
School: conjuration (creation) [poison]; Level druid 7, fungomancer 7

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, M (a collection of different fungal spores worth 500 gp)

EFFECT

Range long (400 ft. + 40 ft./level)
Area 60-ft.-radius burst
Duration instantaneous
Saving Throw Fortitude partial; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

You release a massive burst of various fungal spores.

All creatures in the area take 12d6 points of poison damage and are subject to the following effects:

Blinded for 1d4 rounds
Sickened for 1d4 minutes
Confused for 1 round

A successful Fortitude save halves the damage and negates one of the three effects (creature’s choice).

Additionally, the area is filled with a thick cloud of spores for 1 round per caster level. This cloud functions as obscuring mist, except that it doesn’t move with the wind.
